case.component: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING
case.narrative: The front camera has failed.  The automatic emergency breaking, the adaptive cruise control, and normal cruise control do not work, at all.  The camera began to fail within the first year of ownership but it would start to work shortly after.  After about 1.5 years of ownership, there was a permanent sign of malfunction on the screen, making the above features inoperable.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
